title: Project scope and usage limits
note: The models, devices and single-request behavior the project claims; not an independent measurement.

title: How the work is split across devices
note: Hot experts on the GPU, missed experts on the CPU, n-grams on the SSD, plus MTP / prompt lookup.

title: Versioned performance and reproducibility
note: Performance tables that mix versions, quantized KV (K8V4 can also stream since v0.1.40), low-memory mode and output determinism; not re-measured by this textbook.

title: Model geometry and shape contract
note: 48 layers, 36 GDN / 12 QSA, 512 experts, and check_layer / check_all.

title: Expert cache storage and checks
note: Slots, tiered admission, asynchronous fills, byte checks; the top of the file has comments from earlier phases.

title: Expert sources and ownership
note: A fixed address is not fixed content; routing weights are applied only once; the RAM complement and temporary pointers.

title: Coupled draft sampling
note: Exact match against the target's sampled result; position counters and penalty history; coupling is off by default.

title: Verify window and commit
note: run / commit / wait_commit; GDN, indexer, PLE and KV each commit differently; prefix commit and the pipeline window for batch slots.

title: Draft controller
note: Expected output / cost decision, conditional acceptance rates and EMA; not every call branch was audited.

title: Conversation cache matching rules
note: Token prefix, image identity, steering mode, capacity; not a multi-tenant security contract.

title: PLE row cache and I/O
note: 8-way set associative, rotating replacement within a set, page alignment and the I/O thread.

title: Chunked prefill interface
note: Grouping by expert, the DMA ring, borrowed cache space, multi-GPU chunk pipelining.

title: Sequence state and execution order
note: k=10, per-layer state, shared scratch, layer ranges, graph capture and residual dependencies.

title: Tensor storage contract
note: Byte checks for quantized codes / scale / offset; the weight type, not the name, decides compute dispatch.

title: HTTP and engine boundary
note: FIFO single sequence, Engine.generate, resident subprocess, context rejection, MockEngine.

title: Template and output-parsing front end
note: Message normalization (completed empty assistant turns are not rendered), Jinja templates, incremental parsing of reasoning / content / tool output.

title: GDN math and memory layout
note: Decay comes before the rank-one update; modular head mapping; L2 vs RMS. The layer-count comment at the top is out of date.

title: QSA indexing, paging and selection
note: GQA, page table, indexer, the 2051 width bound, dynamic step buffer. An old MiB comment has a unit error.

title: Upstream MIT license
note: The license of the repository code; it does not replace the licenses of model weights or other third parties.

title: CUDA Programming Guide
note: NVIDIA's official programming guide: threads, memory, synchronization and the execution model.

title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces
note: Free textbook by Remzi and Andrea Arpaci-Dusseau: virtualization, concurrency, persistence.

title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
note: Helps separate IO optimization from changes to which positions attention selects; not a line-by-line design note for this repository.

title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
note: The classic speculative sampling theory, for comparison; do not apply it as-is to Strata's current sampling code.

title: HTML Living Standard: Server-sent events
note: UTF-8, event framing and the incremental parsing rules.

title: Vercel: builds and static output
note: Framework Other, a custom buildCommand and outputDirectory; this textbook needs neither Vite nor a cloud GPU.
